f34031da75310022.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue through a diverse portfolio of beverages and convenient foods, including iconic brands such as LAY’S ®️, DORITOS ®️, CHEETOS ®️, GATORADE ®️, PEPSI ®️, and QUAKER ®️. The company's vision is to be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), an end-to-end transformation focused on sustainability and human capital to create value and growth within planetary boundaries. PepsiCo fosters a dynamic culture driven by passionate teams that embrace new ideas and collaboration. The company is committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce, valuing every voice regardless of background. PepsiCo is an equal opportunity employer, complying with global human rights policies and equality laws, and is Mowaamah -GOLD certified in Saudi Arabia. The Local Selling Team Lead Role As a Local Selling Team Lead within the KSA sales team, this full-time position is responsible for maximizing sales volume, minimizing product stales, achieving distribution targets, implementing merchandising standards, and managing accounts receivable. The role also involves maintaining high levels of customer service and attending training courses to enhance professionalism. The Local Selling Team Lead will conduct daily debriefings with pre-sellers and requires 6-8 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Agree on volume and stales targets with the DSM for customers served by pre-sellers and communicate these to all sales staff. Conduct daily debriefing sessions with pre-sellers, reviewing key measures from KPI reports and providing action plans for performance improvement. Meet weekly with merchandisers to brief them on in-store merchandising arrangements and promotional activities, continuously reviewing arrangements for optimal team utilization. Prepare journey plans for all pre-sellers, confirming customer service frequency, and reviewing daily customer visits during debriefing sessions. Plan holidays and relief cover to ensure continuity of customer service standards, coordinating with the Finance Department to account for outstanding monies before pre-sellers' vacations. Provide on-the-job training by accompanying pre-sellers on their journey plans four days each week, planning trade visits periodically, and supplying the manager with a copy of the plan. Attend monthly team briefing sessions with the DSM, presenting a summary of team performance against plan and agreed actions for the following month, then briefing the team within seven days. Key Performance Indicators Sales volumes versus plan. Achievement of agreed customer service standards. Stales versus target. Customer accounts receivable within agreed terms. Maintenance of agreed merchandising plans in all outlets. Achievement of monthly activity to plan. Qualifications and Experience 6-8 years of relevant experience. Ability to maximize sales volume and achieve distribution targets. Proficiency in implementing merchandising standards. Strong customer service skills and ability to manage accounts receivable. Commitment to continuous professional development through training. Work Type This is a full-time position.

f36d5e98f96c51c6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث CloudTech عن مطور برامج للانضمام إلى فريقها. يتضمن هذا الدور بدوام كامل مسؤوليات متعددة تتعلق بتحليل وتطوير وصيانة الأنظمة، بالإضافة إلى تدريب المستخدمين على التطبيقات. الدور مخصص للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل طبيعة وآلية عمل إجراءات الإدارة. صيانة الأنظمة القائمة. تدريس وتطوير الأنظمة الجديدة. تدريس استخدام نظام التطبيقات للمستخدمين. تصميم تطبيقات جديدة وتطوير النظام العام. المساهمة في إعداد واجهات النظام مع موقع الإشارة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة في استخدام نظام التشغيل ويندوز في تطبيقات مماثلة. إجادة لغة الاستعلام الهيكلية SQL. معرفة كافية بأدوات التطوير الحديثة مثل Visual Studio .NET وJAVA وغيرها. القدرة على إدارة قواعد البيانات مثل MS SQL. شهادة معتمدة من Microsoft. إجادة التعامل مع Oracle Dev Suite 10. بيئة العمل يعمل مطور البرامج ضمن فريق CloudTech في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على التطوير المستمر للأنظمة والتطبيقات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع تقنية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف.

f3c15da88fcbb664.description: شركة رائدة في مجال الصيانة والتشغيل والقوات العاملة عن توفر فرصة وظيفية مسؤول مبيعات وتطوير أعمال – خدمات القوى العاملة “Manpower Sales & Business Development Executive” تبحث شركة فرسان الأداء عن مسؤول مبيعات وتطوير أعمال محترف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة الرياض، يتمتع بخبرة قوية في تسويق وبيع خدمات القوى العاملة واستقطاب العملاء وعقود التوريد والتشغيل داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. المهام والمسؤوليات: استقطاب عملاء جدد وتطوير فرص الأعمال في مجال توفير وإسناد القوى العاملة. بناء وتطوير علاقات مهنية مع الشركات وأصحاب القرار ومديري الموارد البشرية والمشتريات والتشغيل. البحث المستمر عن فرص وعقود جديدة في القطاعات المستهدفة. تقديم خدمات وحلول الشركة للعملاء وإعداد ومتابعة العروض التجارية. التفاوض مع العملاء ومتابعة الفرص البيعية حتى إغلاق العقود. تطوير قاعدة بيانات العملاء والمحافظة على علاقات تجارية طويلة الأمد. متابعة احتياجات العملاء والتنسيق مع الإدارات الداخلية لضمان جودة الخدمة. تحقيق المستهدفات البيعية ومؤشرات الأداء المحددة من الشركة. إعداد تقارير دورية عن المبيعات والفرص والعملاء المحتملين. الشروط والمتطلبات: خبرة عملية من 3 إلى 5 سنوات على الأقل في مجال مبيعات وتسويق خدمات القوى العاملة أو التوظيف أو الإسناد التشغيلي داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. سجل مثبت في استقطاب العملاء وجلب عقود وطلبات توريد القوى العاملة. معرفة جيدة بالسوق السعودي والقطاعات المستهدفة. شبكة علاقات قوية مع الشركات وأصحاب القرار تعتبر ميزة إضافية. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية تحدثًا وكتابة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض والتفاوض وإغلاق الصفقات. حسن المظهر واللباقة والقدرة على تمثيل الشركة بصورة احترافية أمام العملاء. القدرة على العمل وفق مستهدفات بيعية واضحة وتحقيق النتائج. إجادة استخدام Microsoft Office وإعداد العروض والتقارير. الوظيفة دوام كامل (Full-Time). مقر العمل: الرياض – المملكة العربية السعودية. المزايا: راتب أساسي تنافسي + عمولات وحوافز مجزية مرتبطة بالأداء والعقود المحققة. على المرشحين المؤهلين إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع كتابة المسمى الوظيفي “Manpower Sales & Business Development Executive” في عنوان الرسالة.

f3f546a018b6f5a8.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Purchasing Manager to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing all purchasing operations, ensuring adherence to established procedures for ordering, receiving, storing, issuing, and payment of goods. The manager will play a key role in maintaining inventory control and supporting the financial and operational goals of the hotel. Key Responsibilities Manage cross-departmental purchasing work, projects, policies, and standards. Generate accurate and timely reports and presentations. Organize, code, categorize, calculate, tabulate, audit, and verify information or data. Ensure compliance with hygiene, safety, and brand guidelines. Assist the Executive Chef with all aspects of food, beverage, and controlled project purchasing to ensure quality and profitability. Order all food and beverages based on business needs and maintain/reduce budgeted costs. Implement and execute the first-in, first-out inventory rotation principle for all storeroom products. Ensure effective security measures for food and beverage storeroom assets. Collaborate with storeroom personnel and kitchen management to maintain optimal inventory levels. Communicate with kitchen and restaurant management and suppliers to ensure timely deliveries. Check invoices for all received goods to verify quantities, quality, weight, and purchase specifications. Perform daily and period-end food and beverage cost calculations. Maintain inventory control, including date marking, rotation, and requisitions. Complete administrative tasks such as C-7 forms, menu costing, and general office duties. Conduct period-end inventory counts according to standard operating procedures. Communicate pricing and product supply issues to the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef. Receive and inspect all delivered goods and maintain accurate controlled logs and beverage perpetual inventory. Ensure accurate invoice management and proper bookkeeping procedures. Support annual quality audits and review financial statements to identify areas for cost reduction and program improvement. Implement and maintain the hotel's emergency plan, accident prevention plan, and ensure a safe work environment. Accounting and Operational Support Demonstrate a strong understanding of work-related issues, products, systems, and processes. Utilize computer systems and software for data entry and information processing. Apply judgment to ensure compliance with laws, regulations, and standards. Stay current with technology and apply new knowledge to job functions. Lead, influence, and encourage others using strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ensure consistent and timely responses to disciplinary situations and completion of performance appraisals. Submit reports in a timely manner and ensure accurate recording of profits and losses. Monitor applicable taxes to ensure they are current and/or accrued. Provide guidance and assistance to other organizational units on accounting budget policies and procedures. Coordinate and implement assigned accounting work and projects, including audits in all areas of hotel operations. Comply with federal and state laws applicable to operations. Work with the operations team to develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the brand's business strategy. Review guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas for improvement. Participate in hotel inspections to ensure proper maintenance and preventative maintenance processes. Customer and Guest Experience Maintain a professional and friendly demeanor, providing excellent customer service to all guests. Take a proactive approach when addressing customer and guest concerns. Respond to requests from the customer service department in a timely manner. Ensure all team members meet or exceed guest service requirements. Qualifications and Requirements A 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or a related major is required. Ability to analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems. Strong organizational skills and effective time management. Ability to present ideas, expectations, and information in a concise, organized manner. Demonstrated self-confidence, energy, and enthusiasm. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the hospitality industry. The role involves interaction with various departments, suppliers, and hotel management to ensure smooth purchasing operations and overall hotel efficiency.

f36ff73b86a5e22d.description: About the Role Emerson is seeking a Lifecycle Services Sales Leader to drive Lifecycle Services (LCS) orders growth across Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. This full-time position is based in Eastern, Saudi Arabia, and requires strategic thinking, customer focus, and a strong understanding of the regional business and cultural landscape. The role is critical for supporting growth initiatives, enhancing customer satisfaction, and expanding Emerson's Integrated Control and Safety Systems (ICSS) and software footprint within key growth markets. Key Responsibilities Manage the region's Lifecycle Services orders budget and ensure achievement of growth objectives. Drive growth for Guardian Software & Solutions (GSS) and Annual Contract Value (ACV) in alignment with regional plans. Develop lifecycle management plans for the installed base, identifying opportunities for upgrades, cybersecurity solutions, and software subscription expansion. Implement strategies to protect the installed base and promote the adoption of Control Systems and Software (CSS) solutions. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on Lifecycle Services offerings, including Guardian, DeltaV upgrades, cybersecurity solutions, and related services. Engage with customers on greenfield projects early to develop tailored lifecycle support programs. Apply value-based selling methodologies to align software solutions with customer goals, compliance, and business priorities. Partner with service teams to address customer challenges, enhance outcomes, and generate incremental revenue. Maintain an accurate Lifecycle Services sales funnel within CRM systems and ensure alignment with forecasts. Coordinate with sales channels and implement governance practices to ensure compliance with Lifecycle Services policies. Develop and support marketing initiatives to promote DeltaV capabilities and software enhancements. Collaborate with proposal teams to ensure customer-focused, compliant, and timely submissions. Enhance customer satisfaction by identifying solutions for evolving business and operational needs. Build and maintain long-term relationships with customer decision-makers to increase awareness of Emerson's capabilities. Adhere to all Emerson trade compliance, ethics, and business conduct requirements. Support a strong safety culture and contribute to safety objectives. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate builds strong customer relationships and establishes trust through collaboration, responsiveness, and a deep understanding of customer needs. This role requires an individual who consistently achieves results by translating strategic objectives into actionable plans and maintaining focus on priorities in a dynamic environment. Effective communication across diverse stakeholder groups, fostering alignment and productive partnerships, both internally and externally, is essential. The candidate should anticipate future opportunities and challenges, using analytical thinking and sound judgment to develop solutions that create long-term value for customers and the business. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 5-10 years of experience in direct sales and sales leadership within industrial automation, process industries, or related sectors. Experience managing strategic customer relationships within the oil and gas, petrochemical, chemical, or similar industries. Knowledge of control systems, automation technologies, software solutions, or lifecycle services offerings. Ability to travel within the region as needed to support customers and business objectives. Preferred Qualifications Experience with DeltaV systems, Guardian Software & Solutions, cybersecurity offerings, or related automation technologies. Understanding of Lifecycle Services business models, maintenance programs, and software subscription services. Experience developing and executing growth strategies for installed base customers. Familiarity with CRM tools, opportunity management, and forecasting processes. Experience working across multicultural teams and operating within the Saudi Arabian and Bahrain industrial markets. Work Environment This role involves collaboration with a diverse and experienced team, focusing on helping customers maximize the value of their automation investments through Emerson's lifecycle offerings. The position is full-time and requires travel within the region to meet business objectives and support customer needs.

f39b81e32076ac34.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فهد صالح الرشودي وشركاؤه للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومخصص للمهندسين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة، حيث يتطلب من 0 إلى 1 سنة من الخبرة في المجال. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى المهندس المدني مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. كما يشمل الدور إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بسير العمل ونتائج المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة المواصفات الفنية والجودة المطلوبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على فهم وتحليل المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية. معرفة جيدة بأساسيات دراسة المواقع الإنشائية وفحص التربة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة فهد صالح الرشودي وشركاؤه للاستشارات الهندسية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في المشاريع الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

f35bd59758851f86.job_title: MH R Aviation Logs and Records AZ
f35bd59758851f86.description: About the Role Amentum is seeking an MH-60 Aircraft Logs & Records Clerk to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time position is responsible for the comprehensive management of aircraft logbooks, aeronautical equipment service records, and all related maintenance files, reports, directives, and correspondence. The role operates within an aircraft maintenance and operations environment, adhering to CNAFINST *** series and applicable instructions. Key Responsibilities Utilize current management information systems to maintain aircraft forms and records as per customer requirements. Draft and submit aircraft/engine management and Inventory Reporting System reports promptly. Prepare weekly, monthly, and yearly reports as assigned. Process readiness documents, administer the aircraft configuration status accounting program, and verify aircraft utilization reports. Monitor aircraft configuration status, weight and balance, and aircraft inventory data for accuracy. Initiate and distribute applicable maintenance forms in accordance with established procedures. Assist in the preparation of the Monthly Maintenance Plan. Monitor, verify, and log Support Equipment Custody records, Aviation Armament Equipment, aircraft inventory records, and Technical Directives as applicable. Maintain work-center technical publication annex library as required. Provide technical assistance, guidance, and instruction. Perform data processing, data entry, and administrative support within systems such as NALCOMIS Optimized Organizational Maintenance Activity (OOMA), MH-60R Automated Maintenance Environment (AME), Integrated Maintenance Data System (IMDS), Comprehensive Engine Trending and Diagnostics System (CETADS), and Comprehensive Engine Management System (CEMS). Comply with Foreign Object Damage (FOD), Hazardous Waste Program, and Tool Control Programs. Adhere to all established general and industrial safety rules and regulations pertinent to the contract, facility, and job assignment. Qualifications and Requirements Two (2) years of aviation clerical experience in maintaining aircraft logbooks, aeronautical equipment service records, and associated logs. Satisfactory completion of * Armed Forces Logs and Records courses or equivalent curriculum, or two (2) years of on-the-job training and/or experience. High School diploma or equivalent. Ability to meet Government/Company licensing/qualification requirements for the position. Ability to work all assigned shifts and schedules. Valid driver’s license. Ability to obtain and maintain a NAC(T3) Background Investigation and drug test. Ability to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. A secret clearance may be required. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience with US Navy and/or FAA aircraft logbooks and documentation. Demonstrated knowledge of aircraft logbooks, maintenance records, applicable maintenance/technical manuals, publications, and forms. Experience with MH-60R/S, F/A-18 (A-F models), EA-18G, E-2C, and/or F-16N aircraft. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Word, and Excel. Typing speed of a minimum of thirty-five (35) words per minute. Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate in English, and follow verbal and written instructions. Work Environment and Physical Demands The role primarily involves working in an office environment with minimal exposure to noise hazards, though occasional work in aircraft hangar and shop areas may be required. Administrative duties may involve occasional kneeling, standing, stooping, bending, and lifting up to 50 lbs. The position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and keyboard input. Handling of hazardous materials may be necessary. Travel in support of detachments of unknown duration may also be required. Company Commitment Amentum is committed to fostering a strong safety culture, ensuring all employees continuously develop and maintain a safe work environment. Quality is foundational to the business, with a policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Employees are expected to conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and comply with all applicable Quality System documents and customer contracts. Adherence to general and specific operational, safety, quality, and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures, and policies is mandatory.

f395fb13601bd1e2.description: About the Role DP World is seeking a Manager - Security & PFSO to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading the terminal security function to ensure compliance with all relevant security requirements and maintain a secure operating environment. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to oversee and manage all aspects of terminal security at DP World Jeddah. This includes ensuring adherence to company policies, customer expectations, and regulatory standards, while actively contributing to a safe and secure operational setting. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage terminal security operations, including personnel and security supervisors. Ensure compliance with ISPS Code, SAIS, Mawani, DP World Security Standards, and ISO 28001 requirements. Conduct security inspections, patrols, audits, investigations, and risk assessments. Manage security training programs, performance reviews, career development, and succession planning for the security team. Coordinate effectively with external stakeholders such as Police, Coast Guard, Port Security, Mawani, and other relevant authorities. Support the implementation of security plans, access control systems, emergency preparedness protocols, and business continuity initiatives. Monitor security Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), incidents, and identified risks, driving continuous improvement efforts. Oversee security resources, equipment, and operational budgets. Experience Requirements Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in security management, preferably within a port or terminal environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the operations of DP World. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f39d508dd37f49c7.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers in over 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue through a portfolio that includes brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. The company operates with a vision to be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. Role Overview As a SR.Merchandiser at PepsiCo, you will be an integral part of the sales team. This full-time position focuses on maximizing product presence in all assigned outlets. The role involves ensuring adherence to planograms for both on-shelf and off-shelf displays, reporting non-compliance, and conducting in-store sampling or promotions as required. The SR.Merchandiser will also provide market information to pre-sellers to identify selling opportunities. This role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Visit specific Out-of-Home (OT) outlets according to the daily journey plan provided by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products across various access points within OT stores, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point-of-Sale (POS) materials next to SSFL displays as applicable. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on shelves at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Submit daily activity reports for the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling or redemption campaigns when required. Maintain a professional appearance and behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Performance Measures Execution Standard LTA enforcement Journey plan adherence Required Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment PepsiCo fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture where employees are encouraged to embrace new ideas. The company is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, creating a space where every individual has a voice. This is a full-time position within the sales team.

f3a31b35fcbe3767.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Supervisor Stewards to join their team in Makkah. This full-time position involves overseeing and assisting stewards to ensure efficient cleanup operations and maintaining high standards of cleanliness and organization within the kitchen and banquet areas. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Direct and assist stewards to optimize cleanup efficiency. Ensure water temperature and chemical levels are appropriate for cleaning and accurately documented. Support banquet plate-ups and assist cooks and kitchen staff with various tasks as needed. Provide cooks with necessary items and support banquet and buffet operations by transporting and ensuring adequate stock. Return cleaned items to their designated locations. Operate and maintain cleaning equipment and tools, including dishwashing machines, hand wash stations, pot-scrubbing stations, and trash compactors. Team Leadership and Support Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Safety and Compliance Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Guest Service and Physical Requirements Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing their service needs. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Capable of standing, sitting, or walking for extended periods. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Navigate sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces safely. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Experience and Work Environment Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a similar role within the hospitality industry. This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic hotel environment, requiring a proactive approach to maintaining cleanliness and supporting kitchen and banquet operations.

f3c97c90638df7c7.company_name: SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd.
f3c97c90638df7c7.description: About the Role SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd. is seeking an Industrial Hygienist PDE to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on supporting the Industrial Hygiene program to ensure compliance with SAMREF standards and government regulations, thereby protecting employee health and safety. f3a6765dc0b61533.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سالم الحميدي وشركاؤه للتجاره والزراعه عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري الفعال لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمرشحين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى إدارة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقًا لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة منظمة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري أو ما شابه. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية (مثل Microsoft Office). الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام الموكلة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيتم العمل ضمن بيئة مهنية داعمة تتيح للموظف الجديد فرصة لتطوير مهاراته واكتساب خبرة قيمة في مجال الإدارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيناقش خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

f3cb1eeb36fa8357.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike traditional platforms that stop at insights, Lucidya closes the loop. Our proprietary AI is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, enabling teams across marketing, support, and CX to deliver experiences that actually move the needle. We’re scaling fast, and that growth brings complexity. That’s where this role comes in. Why this role matters We’re hiring fast. And hiring fast only works if the foundations behind it are strong. Right now, our People team is lean, and we need someone who can own the operational backbone of how employees join, get set up, and stay compliant. This role is critical to making sure nothing slips, from contracts and payroll to onboarding and government systems. This is not a strategy role. It’s a precision execution role. If things go wrong here, people don’t get paid on time, contracts are delayed, or onboarding becomes messy. If things go right, everything just works, seamlessly. You’ll be the person who makes that happen. What You’ll Do You’ll own the day-to-day operations that keep our People function running smoothly and reliably. Own onboarding execution end-to-end Make sure every new joiner is fully set up before day one, contracts ready, systems updated, no last-minute scrambling Coordinate closely with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to ensure nothing falls through the cracks Ensure payroll runs smoothly and accurately Work closely with Finance to ensure payroll is always correct and on time Catch errors before they become problems Manage contracts and government platforms Prepare and upload contracts through government portals Keep all employee records clean, accurate, and up to date Ensure full compliance with local regulations Maintain clean and reliable systems Keep internal trackers, HR systems, and documentation organized and always up to date Spot inconsistencies and fix them before they escalate Support the team as we scale Help manage increasing hiring volume without compromising quality Be the reliable operator the team depends on when things get busy Who You Are This role is less about years of experience and more about how you work. You’re extremely organized You naturally stay on top of multiple moving parts, deadlines, and details, nothing gets missed. You take ownership of outcomes You don’t just complete tasks, you make sure the result is right. If something is off, you fix it. You communicate clearly and proactively You don’t wait for problems to escalate. You keep stakeholders informed and aligned. You’re reliable under pressure When things get busy (and they will), you stay calm and get things done. You’re detail-obsessed You notice when something doesn’t look right, whether it’s a contract, a payroll number, or a system entry. You’re easy to work with You’ll work across teams daily, being approachable and collaborative matters. What You’ll Need Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in HR Operations. Saudi national (required)Strong HR Operations Background: Someone who is primarily focused on the backend of HR Operations, with the flexibility and ability to step into front-end operations whenever needed. Experience working with government portals or HR systems Familiarity with compliance or labor processes Team Spirit: A strong team player who is collaborative, supportive, and willing to step in wherever needed. Ownership & Accountability: Demonstrates a high level of ownership and accountability, takes initiative, and handles day-to-day decisions independently. However, escalates critical matters and major decisions to the manager for alignment and approval. Saudi Labour Law Expertise: Has in-depth knowledge of Saudi Labour Law, stays up to date with regulatory changes, and can confidently apply it in day-to-day operations. Overall: Looking for someone who is hands-on, operationally strong, detail-oriented, and highly accountable, with the ability to work independently while knowing when to seek managerial guidance. What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) New hires are fully onboarded without delays or issues Payroll runs accurately and on time Contracts are prepared ahead of joining, not after Internal systems and trackers are clean and reliable You’ve built strong working relationships across People, Finance, and TA What the Hiring Process Will Look Like Initial screening call with Talent Acquisition Interview with People team Case Study & presentation interview Final conversation with leadership This role isn’t about big ideas, it’s about consistent, high-quality execution. If you’re someone who takes pride in getting the details right, keeping things organized, and making sure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, you’ll do very well here.

Guest amenities will feature a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two distinct beaches for families and adults, suitable for relaxation or exploring coral reefs. f3f1a5c01fa9372e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج العربي للصيانه والمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءًا من دراسة الموقع وحتى متابعة التنفيذ، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الجوانب الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية للموقع الإنشائي، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. مراجعة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقته للمواصفات والمعايير المحددة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع وإدارة المواقع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة في جميع مراحل العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الخليج العربي للصيانه والمقاولات، حيث تتاح الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f3621ffb9c343d16.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Service Specialist III to join its team in Al Qatif, Al Khobar, or Al Jubail. This full-time role is for experienced professionals who are prepared to manage and execute service line operations for the global energy industry, both onshore and offshore. Role Overview The Service Specialist III supervises and performs all phases of equipment rigging and operation at work locations. This position involves critical planning, direct well site management, and ensuring customer satisfaction through effective service delivery and communication. The role also includes mentoring junior staff and maintaining equipment standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise, direct, and execute all phases of rigging up and down service line equipment at work locations, both onshore and offshore. Provide necessary planning for jobs, including equipment setup, well site direction, and customer support activities. Manage activities related to maintaining, setting up, testing, and operating equipment at customer locations and field camps. Mentor and train lower-level Service Operators and Operator Assistants in areas of expertise. Monitor instruments and perform calculations to ensure data quality at the well site. Consult with customers regarding services and products, foster positive customer relations at the well site, and ensure customer satisfaction. Properly maintain equipment and complete all required job documentation. Conduct pre-job toolbox safety meetings, review and verify job plans with customer representatives, and manage any required changes. Review information from Business Development to confirm adherence to best practices and ensure proposed job plans meet customer expectations efficiently. Communicate with other Product Service Lines (PSLs) and third parties to ensure tool and well site activity compatibility. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma. A minimum of 9+ years of experience in oil field drilling activities. At least 5+ years of experience specifically in underbalanced drilling and/or managed pressure drilling. Strong mathematical acumen. Proficient reading comprehension and writing skills. Compensation Compensation for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with experience. About Halliburton Halliburton is one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The company focuses on attracting and retaining talent by investing in employee development and career growth.

f3b03f2821bd2596.description: About the Social Media Lead Role at Tabby Tabby | تابي is seeking a Social Media Lead to manage its public customer support presence across various platforms, including X, Instagram, Facebook, app stores, and review sites. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring customers receive effective solutions to their issues in the public sphere. The role requires 4+ years of experience and offers a salary range of SR25,000 - SR31,000 per month. Role Context and Focus While Tabby's Marketing team manages brand accounts and image, this role concentrates on public customer service. The Social Media Lead will define the brand's voice in public interactions, publish content, foster a customer community, and manage public incidents. The primary market for this role is Saudi Arabia, with secondary coverage extending to the UAE. The ideal candidate is a Saudi national with a deep understanding of local cultural nuances, humor, and what builds brand credibility in the region. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the tone of voice and standards for public replies in both Arabic and English, ensuring consistency in customer interactions. Develop proactive content such as FAQs, explainers, announcements, and how-to guides covering payments, limits, disputes, and contact methods to address recurring public issues. Build and nurture a support community where Tabby can post initial information and customers can ask questions. Monitor and manage Tabby's presence in public ratings and reviews across app stores, Trustpilot, and other platforms, tracking sentiment and share of voice on service topics. This includes deciding on response strategies and organizing the team to implement them. Manage the support aspect of incidents and public escalations, coordinating with Marketing, Legal, and Compliance to determine communication strategies. Report on the public delivery of Tabby's support, providing actionable recommendations to the business. Channel public customer feedback to the Customer Experience and Product teams. Ensure the quality of public replies by setting standards, which the Quality team will measure and team leaders will reinforce with agents. Develop training materials and conduct sessions to enhance agent skills in tone and public writing. Collaborate with Marketing on the content calendar, serving as the Customer Experience counterpart to align support and campaigns. Team Structure and Collaboration The Social Media support team in KSA comprises approximately 16 individuals, with day-to-day management of queues, shifts, and agent performance handled by operations managers and team leaders. This role will collaborate closely with Marketing on content and campaigns, with Legal and Compliance for incident management, and with Customer Experience and Product teams for feedback integration. Operational aspects such as queue management, scheduling, SLAs, productivity, headcount, agent appraisals, and discipline are managed by operations. Brand accounts and campaigns are handled by Marketing, regulatory rules by Compliance, and tool selection by CRM and IT. Candidate Requirements 4+ years of experience in a relevant social media or customer support role. Saudi national with a deep understanding of local conversation, including platforms, humor, cultural references, and factors establishing brand credibility in the region. Proficiency in defining and maintaining tone of voice for public interactions in both Arabic and English. Demonstrated ability to develop proactive content and manage public ratings and reviews. Experience in coordinating with multiple departments during public incidents. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined qualifications are encouraged to apply for this position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

f3d2236bd08a282d.description: About the Role Jotun is seeking a Senior Sales Executive - Projects to join their team. This full-time position is based at Red Sea and reports to the Area Sales Manager – Project. The role involves driving business-to-business sales of Jotun Decorative products to new, existing, and targeted project customers, focusing on achieving sales targets, gross margin, DSO, and market share while ensuring sustainable profitability. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell Decorative products to construction projects within an assigned geographical territory through regular customer visits and identification of new business opportunities. Gather market insights and competitive intelligence, and build strong customer relationships to support sustainable business growth and achieve sales targets. Conduct systematic ground mapping and regular area audits of ongoing and upcoming construction and infrastructure projects to identify decorative painting opportunities and assess market potential. Build, maintain, and continuously update a qualified sales pipeline in CRM, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, stage management, and sales forecasting aligned with sales top-line and budget targets. Monitor awarded projects throughout execution to maintain Jotun's position, defend the agreed project scope against competitor penetration, and ensure project requirements are met. Proactively manage assigned accounts through diligent follow-up, reconciliation, and documentation to ensure adherence to credit terms and achievement of DSO targets. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service. Interpret project technical documents to provide accurate product recommendations, quotations, and ensure compliance with project specifications. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree is required. A degree in Sales, Marketing, Engineering, or Building Materials is preferred. A minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Project Sales, B2B, and Business Development is essential. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this position.

f31d4c3b23597972.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم عمليات إنشاء الأبنية، وضمان مطابقة المواصفات الفنية، وتقدير الاحتياجات من المواد والعمالة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة موقع البناء، ومواد الإنشاء، والخلطات الإسمنتية، وإرسالها إلى المختبر للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. تفقد العمل في إنشاء الأبنية أثناء وبعد التنفيذ لضمان الالتزام بالمواصفات الفنية المحددة. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق المباشر مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإنشاءات أو دور فني ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية. معرفة بجمع العينات من تربة الموقع والمواد الإنشائية. القدرة على مطابقة المواصفات الفنية للمشاريع. مهارات تقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المرافق، ويسهم بشكل مباشر في جودة المشاريع الإنشائية للشركة. ملخص الدور يعد هذا الدور فرصة لفني إنشاءات ذي خبرة للمساهمة في مشاريع شركة شلفا لإدارة المرافق في الرياض. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بمهام فنية حيوية لضمان جودة البناء ومطابقة المواصفات، مما يدعم الأهداف التشغيلية للشركة.

f3693f7be1c3ea9d.description: About the Role: Fraud Prevention Officer Bin Yaala for Exchange is seeking a Fraud Prevention Officer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on supporting fraud detection, transaction monitoring, alert analysis, and investigations. The officer will ensure compliance with internal policies and applicable Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) regulations. Core Responsibilities Monitor foreign exchange transactions, remittance services, and digital channels to identify unusual activities and potential fraud indicators. Review, analyze, and classify fraud detection alerts based on risk levels. Collect and document relevant information and evidence to support preliminary fraud investigations. Analyze fraud patterns, manipulation techniques, and misuse of financial services. Prepare investigation reports, findings, and recommendations for the Fraud Management Unit Manager. Support the review and enhancement of fraud prevention controls, detection scenarios, and early-warning indicators. Coordinate with relevant departments to follow up on fraud cases and implement approved corrective and preventive actions. Maintain accurate fraud incident records and track cases through resolution and closure. Ensure confidentiality, evidence integrity, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal procedures. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi nationality is required. Bachelor's degree in Law. 1–3 years of hands-on experience in fraud prevention, fraud investigation, or AML/transaction monitoring. Internships and training programs are not counted towards this experience. Previous experience in banking, foreign exchange, remittance, or financial services is preferred. Good understanding of fraud prevention regulations and applicable SAMA requirements. Applications that do not meet the Law degree and fraud experience requirements will not be considered. Required Skills Strong investigative, evidence-gathering, analytical, and reporting skills. Ability to work with transaction monitoring systems and fraud detection alerts. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Professional certifications such as CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner) or CAFS (Certified Anti-Fraud Specialist) are an advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the financial services sector at Bin Yaala for Exchange. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role.

f3864a7644bd938d.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a QA/QC Manager to lead and manage the Quality Control and Quality Assurance functions for an assigned location in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves close collaboration with the head of operations and other functional managers to ensure products consistently meet or exceed customer expectations and adhere to all quality and compliance standards. Key Responsibilities Enforce the implementation of quality control plans and procedures to ensure compliance with industry standards, customer requirements, and regulatory mandates. Ensure all delivered products meet or exceed customer expectations and satisfy quality and compliance standards. Conduct regular quality audits to verify adherence to established quality standards and procedures. Collaborate with functional managers to identify and resolve quality issues, driving continuous improvement in product quality. Manage the non-conformance and corrective action process, ensuring timely and effective resolution of quality issues. Ensure all quality documentation is accurate, complete, up-to-date, and properly stored and maintained. Develop and deliver quality training programs to ensure all employees are aware of quality standards and procedures. Supervise all QA/QC plans, including amendments and revisions, to meet project quality requirements and client expectations. Establish project quality objectives aligned with IMS corporate objectives and monitor the submission of QA/QC reports. Build and implement a control system for suppliers and subcontractors. Manage and attend all required meetings, arranging project quality requirements with the project owner/consultant and project management team. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control roles. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement quality control plans and procedures. Experience managing a team of Quality Control and Quality Assurance professionals. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working closely with operational and functional managers within a dynamic environment focused on maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.

f3b1a164d611a51d.description: About Autobia Autobia is a Saudi technology company established in Dammam in 2021. The company focuses on building an ecosystem to support the growth of the traditional retail sector, with a primary focus on the auto parts market. Role Overview Autobia is seeking a Supplier Master Data Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of supplier pricing data. The specialist will monitor compliance with agreed quotations, prepare accurate pricing files, and maintain parts and price master data within the system to support both Sales and Procurement departments. The position reports directly to the Supplier Relations Manager and involves close collaboration with Sales and Procurement teams to maintain clean, compliant, and up-to-date pricing information. Key Responsibilities Receive, review, and format supplier quotations, ensuring accuracy free from calculation or typing errors, before submission for approval to the Supplier Relations Manager. Conduct daily reviews of system prices against agreed supplier rates, promptly flagging any discrepancies or unapproved price changes. Update system prices based on newly approved supplier quotations. Upload prices, descriptions, and brand information for new parts into the system. Deactivate unavailable parts and ensure catalog data remains complete and consistent. Analyze pricing data to identify trends, anomalies, and recurring supplier issues, sharing insights with the Supplier Relations Manager. Respond to inquiries from Sales and Procurement regarding pricing and part availability. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in master data management or a similar field. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

f36fb02fe31bf429.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نمو اعمال للتشغيل والصيانة عن رسام هندسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قراءة وتفسير المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى رسمها وتحريرها باستخدام الأدوات اليدوية والبرمجيات المتخصصة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان إعداد رسومات هندسية دقيقة وواضحة لدعم العمليات التشغيلية والصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام مسودات الرسوم الهندسية ومناقشتها مع المهندس المختص لتفسيرها وإعداد الرسومات والتصاميم الهندسية والرسوم التنفيذية. رسم المخططات والرسوم التنفيذية يدوياً باستخدام أدوات وطاولة الرسم المخصصة. إعداد المخططات الهندسية والرسوم التنفيذية باستخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على جهاز الحاسوب. تدقيق الرسوم الأولية وتقديمها للمهندس المختص، ثم إعداد الرسوم النهائية بناءً على التوجيهات والملاحظات. طباعة المخططات النهائية باستخدام برامج الحاسوب مع الالتزام بمقياس الرسم المطلوب. تصنيف وفهرسة وتوثيق وترتيب وحفظ المخططات الهندسية بشكل منهجي لضمان سهولة الوصول إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الرسم الهندسي. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية بدقة. إتقان استخدام برمجيات الرسم الهندسي على الحاسوب. مهارات جيدة في الرسم اليدوي باستخدام الأدوات التقليدية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الرسام الهندسي ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم عمليات التشغيل والصيانة، مما يتطلب التعاون الفعال مع المهندسين والزملاء الآخرين. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة نمو اعمال للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا الدور.

f394e56451657b01.description: About the Role Baazeem Trading Company is seeking an experienced Salesperson to join its sales team in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing and developing sales within outstation areas, requiring a professional with 5-10 years of experience in the FMCG industry. Key Responsibilities Achieve assigned sales, distribution, collection, and coverage targets. Manage and develop customer accounts within the designated territory. Ensure effective market coverage through regular customer visits. Develop existing accounts and identify opportunities for new customer acquisition. Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure high service levels. Monitor product availability, visibility, pricing, and competitor activities in the market. Execute sales plans, promotions, and company initiatives effectively. Ensure timely collection of customer payments and proper account follow-up. Prepare and submit regular sales and market reports. Demonstrated experience across multiple sales channels, including Traditional Trade, Wholesale, Modern Trade, and Key Accounts. f32c626363b491a2.description: About the Role Talents Sea is seeking a Logistics Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning, coordinating, and controlling all logistics activities for HV/EHV Underground Cable (UGC) projects. The manager will ensure the timely and safe movement, storage, handling, and delivery of cables, equipment, materials, and project resources to and from project sites. The position requires close coordination with various internal and external stakeholders, including Project Management, Procurement, Warehouse, Engineering, Construction, HSE, QA/QC, suppliers, transporters, and client representatives, to ensure uninterrupted project execution and compliance with project requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive logistics plans for projects. Plan and coordinate the transportation of materials, equipment, tools, and project resources. Coordinate delivery schedules with Procurement, Warehouse, Construction, and Project teams. Ensure materials are delivered to project sites according to approved schedules and operational priorities. Arrange suitable transportation, including heavy-haulage and specialized vehicles as required. Coordinate loading, unloading, lifting, positioning, and handling of sensitive materials and equipment. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of materials to prevent damage. Plan delivery routes considering road restrictions, bridge and load limitations, traffic conditions, access constraints, and site conditions. Coordinate with local authorities, transport contractors, and relevant stakeholders to obtain transportation permits and approvals. Monitor transportation activities and ensure timely delivery to project locations. Coordinate logistics requirements for installation, testing, and commissioning activities. Ensure the availability and timely mobilization of equipment, tools, temporary facilities, and site resources. Coordinate material movements between project sites, warehouses, and storage facilities. Maintain accurate records of material dispatches, deliveries, transportation documents, and delivery acknowledgements. Monitor logistics costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors regarding delivery schedules and logistics requirements. Verify delivery documentation, packing lists, delivery notes, and material quantities. Coordinate with warehouse and store teams for receiving, inspection, storage, and release of materials. Ensure appropriate storage conditions for materials, equipment, and other project resources. Support project teams in resolving delivery delays, transportation issues, material damage, and site access constraints. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly logistics reports for management. Monitor logistics KPIs, delivery performance, vehicle utilization, and transportation costs. Ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, HSE requirements, and local regulations. Ensure all transportation and lifting activities are performed safely and in accordance with approved procedures. Coordinate with HSE teams on vehicle safety, lifting plans, route assessments, and transportation risk assessments. Manage logistics subcontractors, transport companies, drivers, and service providers. Maintain proper documentation for vehicles, drivers, permits, insurance, and transportation activities. Provide logistics support during project mobilization, demobilization, and final removal of materials and equipment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in logistics management, preferably within the HV/EHV Underground Cable (UGC) project sector. f33cccb273dcfb3e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المتميزون الحديثة العقارية عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مسؤولية تنفيذ المهام التالية: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات والتوربينات، ووحدات التكييف، والمراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو ما يعادلها. الموقع ونوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق المتميزون الحديثة العقارية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مكة المكرمة.
